| Seam | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `dist/recorder/rename_no_replace.node` | Removed from Git index; worktree host binding kept as generated output |
| `.gitignore` | Exact path `dist/recorder/rename_no_replace.node` ignored |
| `test/recorder-package-lifecycle.test.ts` | Isolated clean-checkout lifecycle regression: no initial binding; install builds host-loadable binding; source/build scripts stay tracked; prepack/pack includes binding + C source + publisher and no scratch; packed foreign producer seed replaced by host-magic loadable `renameNoReplace`; repeated install → `build:native` → prepack/pack leaves empty porcelain each time |

**Not changed:** `scripts/build-rename-no-replace.mjs` (sole publisher, atomic same-FS staging rename), `scripts/rename_no_replace.c`, `package.json` (pack inventory already ships on-disk generated binding under `files`; no second publisher), CI foreign-binding proof, Recorder spawn/publication behavior, Souls/schemas/runtime.
